# Unify Consulting () - SVP Technical Pre-Sales and Enterprise Solution Architecture briefing packet

## JD Complement
Unify Consulting is not a pure software vendor; it is a consulting-led firm that sells transformation, then has to prove it can land and expand through delivery. This role likely exists to bridge advisory credibility with executable
solution design, especially where AI, data, and cloud choices must be made credible to enterprise buyers.

The operating tension is between bespoke client strategy and repeatable, partner-aligned solution patterns. The role likely has to turn high-level consulting narratives into concrete architectures, demos, and pilot plans that survive
procurement, security review, and delivery handoff.

## Company DNA & Operating Model
Unify Consulting presents as a management consulting and business services firm with an AI-management-consulting positioning. Its core identity is strategy plus implementation, not product-only selling.

The company’s public framing emphasizes connecting strategy, AI, data, and people to drive transformation at scale. That suggests a hybrid archetype: services-led with platform and partner leverage, especially where enterprise modernization
needs both advisory and technical execution.

The central tension for this role is to keep the firm differentiated as a flexible, high-trust alternative to larger consultancies while still making solutioning concrete enough to win complex enterprise pursuits.

## Company Strategy & Operating Pressure
Verified company descriptions place Unify Consulting in advisory services spanning business strategy, organizational effectiveness, product management, and AI/data transformation. It was founded in 2006 and operates across multiple
locations.

That profile implies pressure to stay relevant in a market where buyers expect consulting firms to speak fluently about AI, cloud, and data platforms while also showing implementation depth. The role likely helps convert that market
expectation into a repeatable pre-sales motion.

The operating-model shift is from broad advisory positioning toward sharper solution articulation: what gets recommended, what gets piloted, what gets handed to delivery, and what can be co-sold with ecosystem partners.

## Leadership & Stakeholder Map
Verified public material does not provide a complete leadership map here, so avoid over-specifying org structure. The likely stakeholder set is clear from the business model.

Expect close interaction with consulting leadership, delivery leaders, partner/alliance owners, and client-facing principals. On the buyer side, the role likely needs to align with business sponsors, enterprise architects, data leaders,
cloud platform owners, and procurement/security stakeholders.

Because the firm sells transformation services, internal alignment matters as much as external persuasion: pre-sales must stay connected to delivery feasibility and margin discipline.

## AI, Data, Platform, Architecture Signals
Unify’s public positioning explicitly ties together strategy, AI, data, and people. That is a strong signal that architecture conversations are not isolated technical exercises; they are part of business transformation narratives.

The company also publicly references advanced Salesforce solutions, including Data Cloud, Experience Cloud, Service Cloud, and Billing Cloud. That suggests the role may need to translate enterprise architecture into CRM, data, and
customer-experience modernization patterns.

The firm’s partnership messaging with digital and cloud technology leaders indicates a practical architecture stance: use partner platforms to accelerate implementation rather than inventing from scratch.

## Partnership / Ecosystem Motion
Partnership motion is material here. Unify publicly emphasizes partnerships and alliances with major technology providers and says it brings strategy informed by implementation experience.

The Google Cloud partnership is especially relevant because it signals cloud and data-platform credibility, including data storage, warehousing, and visualization with Looker. That makes co-sell and joint-solution storytelling part of the
company’s go-to-market DNA.

For this role, ecosystem fluency likely matters in three ways: shaping solution choice, validating technical roadmaps with partners, and making the firm look credible in enterprise buying cycles where vendor alignment is scrutinized.

## Recent Events & Urgency
The most recent verified signals are the company’s continued emphasis on AI-driven transformation, its Salesforce solution focus, and its partner ecosystem messaging. Those point to a firm sharpening its market story around practical
modernization.

The urgency for this role likely comes from enterprise buyers demanding faster proof: not just strategy decks, but demoable architectures, pilot outcomes, and a clean path from pre-sales to delivery.

The broader market pressure is that consulting firms are increasingly judged on whether they can operationalize AI and cloud modernization without overpromising or creating delivery risk.

## apps_rg Positioning Themes (targeting only, not proof)
- Consulting-led transformation, not product-only engineering
- Enterprise solution architecture that connects strategy to implementation
- AI and data modernization framed through business outcomes
- Cloud and platform fluency with partner-backed credibility
- Pre-sales rigor that protects delivery feasibility
- Pilot design that can become a repeatable delivery motion
- Stakeholder alignment across business, architecture, and delivery
- Ecosystem-aware solutioning with hyperscaler and platform partners

## apps_lic Outreach Angles (targeting only, not proof)
- Reference Unify’s strategy-plus-implementation positioning, not generic consulting language
- Mention the need to make AI and data transformation concrete for enterprise buyers
- Tie the conversation to partner-backed cloud and platform roadmaps
- Speak to the handoff from solution design to delivery without losing momentum
- Use Salesforce and Google Cloud as examples of the kind of platform depth that matters
- Frame the role around repeatable solution patterns, not one-off decks
- Signal awareness that consulting firms win by making architecture commercially credible

## Do Not Use As Proof
The JD and this briefing are targeting inputs only. Candidate claims must come from the governed resume/proof graph, not from this packet.
